notes.title: Game Not Launching Fix
notes.content:
Apparently games that were made with [b]Game Maker[/b] are having these problem. It's probably not on our end but we're still looking it up.

[b]Try these fixes:[/b]

[b](Option 1)[/b]
Opting out of the Steam client beta:
go to Steam settings > Account > opt out of the beta.

[b](Option 2)[/b]
(This method won't count playtime and achievements, but it makes the game work)
Navigate to your Reigning Cats directory (right click on Reigning Cats in your Steam library > Properties > Local files tab > Browse local files).
You should see Reigning Cats.exe and a bunch of files.
Delete steam_api.dll and launch the game.

notes.title: Quick Patch 1.0.1.2
notes.content:
If you are experiencing the [b]Infinite Loading Screen[/b] just press the "End" key on your keyboard. If you are at the Final Boss it will automatically load the Ending Scene.
Otherwise it will take you to the main/town screen.

If you are hearing some odd music or sound effects, just simply restart the game.

I apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
The free items and free mercs will now be used and deducted accordingly instead of using gold in [b]Revenge of the Big Bad Wolf[/b], [b]War, War Never Ends[/b], and [b]Survive The Night[/b].

This way finding items or winning free mercs in mini games such as [i]"Potty"[/i] and [i]"Chow"[/i] won't become pointless after beating the game.

-You can now place a [b]Cat[/b] on a [b]Lamp Post[/b].
-You can now place a [b]Super Bubble[/b] on a [b]Lamp Post[/b].

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Hi guys,
I realize that it has been frustrating for a lot of you having to go through a tedious task, especially doing something that we all hate to do in real life...
Cleaning cat litter box!
So I decided, that I won't be so cruel and make it more fun and rewarding to clean a virtual litter box :)

So hopefully this will make the game more fun than frustrating.

Enjoy guys!

1.0.0.7

[b]LITTERBOX MINIGAME[/b]
-Higher chance of lucky find
-Faster pace Litterbox minigame
-Better chance to find hidden treasure

**Added loading requirement to better handle memory and sprites.
**Added Steam F12 Screen Shot functionality

Added "[b]Choose Game Mode[/b]" at the beginning of the game
[b]- Happy Kingkat:[/b]
	No more donations at the beginning of a battle.
	No scoop counter to unlock free items
	No penalty for retreating during battle.

[b]- Greedy Kingkat[/b]
	Donations to Kingkat at the beginning of a battle.
	Scoop counter is enabled to unlock free items
	Penalty for retreating during battle.


Please log off your Steam and log back in to update Reigning Cats.

notes.title: In Game Game Guide
notes.content:
Hello guys,
First, thank you for all who up voted in greenlight.
I released the game as soon as it was greenlit, and that was my big mistake. Since I overlooked the most important part of a game... An In-game Guide!
I apoplogize that I got so excited and published it without thinking.
I'm currently working on it as I speak, because I feel bad to those who purchased the game and not be able to enjoy it.

In the meantime please refer to braain's BASIC GUIDE TO REIGNING CATS in community guide.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=508608703

I put a lot of love into this game and I want everyone to have fun with it.

Again thank you! and I'm getting back to work...
